verdicts.reason: A has a real collision: the 'Find It Near You' button sits on top of the 'Summer Only' badge and cuts it off. The CTA text is also jammed inside its pill, and the phone is cropped at the top and bottom edges. B has no collisions, but 'SOLSTICE' is pushed right up against the headline, there's a dead gap between the phone and the copy, and the CTA is the same size as the badges, so it doesn't stand out.
